The included cooking guide has made the transition very easy and it's a lot better for cooking for groups since I can maintain even heat the entire time i'm grilling.

Results.ReviewText: My wife and I bought this grill about 1.5 months ago and have gotten a lot of use out of it and are very happy with the results. However, a couple days ago when wheeling the grill across our poured pad outback one of the wheels came off. I immediately assumed it popped out of place somehow as the wheels just pop-in, however, it was actually bused. Unsure if there was a slight, hair crack initially or how this happened but now I am in search of a replacement wheel so get my grill back in order.

Results.ReviewText:
While you can buy a lass expensive grill, you won’t find one built this well for less. 
It gets hot fast, and it holds its heat better than other grills I have owned. The side shelves come in handy while I am using it, and I can fold them up when I am done. You do have less real estate to work with, so plan accordingly when deciding what you are going to grill. It is a great grill for direct grilling. But you might want to use a different grill to do indirect cooking if you have a large piece of meat to cook. I have a smoker for that though.
I bought this grill to do steaks, burgers, bratwurst, etc… on our small deck. It has not disappointed me. I would definitely recommend it.
Results.Title: Great little grill for a small space!

Results.ReviewText: We LOVE our Spirit. It’s the perfect size for us, and we can do everything we want. We’ve already done indirect pork tenderloin and chicken and regular burgers. All turned out fabulous. I love the cooking guide and the manual is excellent on how to start amd maintain the grill.
Results.Title: Love our Spirit

Results.ReviewText:
Cooks food evenly.

Results.Title: Chilling and grilling

Results.ReviewText: This is by far the best gas grill we have ever purchased.  It preheats quickly and if you follow the instructions on the Weber App you can’t go wrong even if your a novice at grilling.  This is by far our favorite investment for food preparation!  This is a small grill and I am guessing it weighs over 100 pounds and is sturdy.  The quality of the steel and the workmanship are superior to anything we have owned in the last thirty years.  Overall you can’t go wrong for the price versus quality, it’s well worth the cost.  Our grill was purchased through Amazon and shipped.  Two of the heavy steel panels had small dents obviously from shipping I contacted Weber support and sent a couple of photos because we assembled the grill to use and had already used it once.  Theee days later UPS delivered the two panels to replace my dented ones.  Excellent customer service/support as well.
Results.Title: Ease of use, quality and customer support

Results.ReviewText: This grill is great!!!!  The electric ignition works perfectly. I love the grill marks that it leaves on our food.  The temperature reading makes it so nice to cook on since I am able to control the amount of heat.  This leads to food that is cooked to perfection.  Thanks Weber for a wonderful product.
Results.Title: Thanks Weber Grills

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
